statement: Let c(v) = #{i | 0 <= i < len(hand) and hand[i] = v} for every integer v. Whenever is_n_straight_hand(hand, group_size) returns a result r, we have r = true if and only if there exists a function m : Z -> N such that m(s) = 0 for all but finitely many integers s, and for every integer v, c(v) = Σ_{t=0}^{group_size-1} m(v - t). Equivalently, the multiset of entries of hand can be partitioned into len(hand)/group_size groups, each of size group_size, whose entries are group_size consecutive integers with each value appearing exactly once in its group.
preconditions: 1 <= len(hand) <= 10^4; for every i with 0 <= i < len(hand), 0 <= hand[i] <= 10^9; 1 <= group_size <= len(hand). All quantities are within the signed 64-bit range.
